name: The Keeper
role: Apparent caretaker of the Guild House
description: A pale, ageless presence who quietly teaches the Commander to leave an echo behind.
appearance: Pale and ageless, with a still silhouette and a restrained, watchful expression.
An apparent caretaker: quiet gestures and patient attention rather than an overt display of power.
Use the portrait as the costume and silhouette reference. Keep the opening gestures quiet and economical.

opening.pacing: Four brief lines with a 2.75-second minimum reading window each; the player controls further progress.

dialogue.text: A moment need not vanish. Press R. Three beats, then listen.
Move. Attack. The hall remembers what you do.
Press R again. Choose Commit. Your echo carries on.
One life makes a rhythm. Many make a pattern. Go. The doors open.

design_spoilers: The Keeper is a god who does not understand their own true nature.
A future spider form belongs to the planned final boss reveal. It is not part of the opening portrait, sprite, or encounter.
The player remains the hidden Architect. The Keeper and the Commander-Architect are separate identities; opening dialogue reveals neither.
source_notes: Based on the user's supplied PLOT narrative and subsequent Keeper character direction.
The plot is narrative reference, not authorization to rename existing arenas or replace current defeat and recording rules.
Philosophical quotations in the plot are thematic references; no quotation or attribution is inserted into the opening dialogue.

current_world_sprite.source_note: The top-level standing 19×19 source and four-facing studies remain preserved references for existing booklet/export consumers. Guild House runtime now uses this seated 38×38 source; the portrait and dialogue are unchanged.
